notes: Linear-drive (LPO) module; LPO module does not have a CDR. Forward error correction (FEC) is required to be implemented by the host. Power dissipation stated as < 11 W (Typical 10W) for single-ended; Maximum Power Consumption per End 11 W. Case operating temperature 0°C to 70°C without air flow. Optical transmission distance maximum 100 m per Recommended Operating Conditions; standard cable lengths 1, 5, 10, 30, 50, 100 meters on SMF. Maximum aggregate data rate 1.6 Tb/s; maximum data rate per lane 212.5 Gb/s. Each channel data rate 106.25 GBd @ PAM4 (optical). Power supply 3.3 V (3.135–3.465 V); ICC 3333 mA typical when Vcc is 3.3 V single-ended.
